behavior: Server reads only cookies().has for the existing cart cookie protocol, never its value.

A present cookie, including malformed or stale credentials, still reaches the original private BFF validation.
Manual cart reads, initialization, response schemas, CSRF checks and mutation recovery are unchanged.
Both production provider entry points pass the request-scoped hint; independent providers retain the previous restore-by-default behavior.
